480:t_009:6.en:
$$万丈$$
「Let's do this, everyone! Our target is $$エルーナルーナ$$!」

480:t_009:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「All of us will protect everyone in $$チームＤ$$!」

480:t_009:9.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「So, $$葵$$! Please wake up soon!」

480:t_009:10.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「So, $$葵$$! Please wake up soon!」

480:t_009:11.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「HA! It's party time!」

480:t_010:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Nice, $c! It isn't just that girl and darling! You're all fun!」

480:t_010:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「And it's all thanks to that girl's blood of the beast!」

480:t_010:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Quit getting carried away all by yourself!」

480:t_011:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You're hanging in there, $c! Is that girl's blood of the beast to thank for this, too?!」

480:t_011:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Quit getting carried away all by yourself!」

480:t_012:0.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Damn it! That woman's ship keeps powering up!」

480:t_012:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「Is that the $$スフィア$$'s power reacting to her desire?!」

480:t_012:2.en:
$$凱$$
「So the more she enjoys the fight, the stronger she gets?!」

480:t_012:3.en:
$$渓$$
「How much more ridiculous can that woman get?!」

480:t_012:5.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「I know. Like $$チームＤ$$, that woman has a wild spirit.」

480:t_012:6.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「If we can shatter her fighting spirit, even for an instant, we should be able to stop her.」

480:t_012:10.en:
$$シモン$$
「What the hell are you doing, $$葵$$?! Wake up already and scare the living daylights out of that cow!」

480:t_012:12.en:
$$シモン$$
「She encouraged me when Bro died, and when I proposed to $$ニア$$.」

480:t_012:13.en:
$$シモン$$
「So now it's my turn to help $$葵$$!」

480:t_012:14.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Hold on, $$シモン$$! You aren't the only ones who owe them!」

480:t_012:15.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Their wild spirit has always ignited our fighting spirit.」

480:t_012:16.en:
$$タケル$$
「Even when they acted cool, $$チームＤ$$ always had fire in their hearts.」

480:t_012:17.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「When I see that, I want to roar like a beast, too! Raaawr!」

480:t_012:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「So let us hear it again, $$葵$$! That fiery roar of yours!」

480:t_012:20.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「It's no use! Their fangs are already broken!」

480:t_012:21.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「They have indeed been defeated... For wild animals, that means death...」

480:t_012:22.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「But they are not beasts! They are humans with a wild spirit!」

480:t_012:23.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So they will rise again, as many times as it takes! By their own will! To fight the enemy they must defeat!」

480:t_013:2.en:
$$青山$$
「But something like a $$次元震|lc$$ happened just before that...!」

480:t_013:3.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「That is no spare. It is the true Dankuuken.」

480:t_013:6.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Only one Dankuuken exists in all the universes... Now it is passed down, along with their souls.」

480:t_013:9.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「And feel it! The feelings held within the Dankuuken!」

480:t_014:2.en:
$$葵$$
「I feel them... The feelings held within this blade...」

480:t_014:5.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「A loving heart tore through that evil space.」

480:t_014:6.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「And through the fog that covered our hearts, too.」

480:t_014:7.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Nice work! Though I'd rather you had stayed asleep!」

480:t_015:0.en:
$$メール$$
「$$エルーナルーナ$$ is coming!」

480:t_016:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You're going to try the same thing again?! You dumb animals never learn!」

480:t_016:1.en:
$$葵$$
「Sorry, $$エルーナルーナ$$! We're not beasts!」

480:t_016:3.en:
$$朔哉$$
「That's how we got back on our feet!」

480:t_016:4.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「And we can feel our bonds with the people we care about...」

480:t_016:5.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「And turn them into strength!」

480:t_016:6.en:
$$葵$$
「Take this! This Dankuuken holds the souls of everyone who supports $$チームＤ$$!」

480:t_017:1.en:
$$葵$$
「We aren't done yet, $$エルーナルーナ$$! We won't stop!」

480:t_018:0.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Fly, $$チームＤ$$! Carry the feelings of so many people toward the future humanity must reach!」

480:t_019:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「That truly was an explosion of wild spirit.」

480:t_019:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「And their will controls it... Their feelings themselves.」

480:t_019:4.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Yes. They have transcended beasts... And now they are about to transcend humanity.」

480:t_019:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That hurt...! It's been ages since anything made my head spin!」

480:t_020:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Sorry, $$ダバラーン$$. The mission's a failure.」
